attributes.name: Disable Mechanism
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to evade a bane you encounter that has the Construct, Lock, or Trap trait.

Discard this card to add 2d8 to any Disable check.

Discard this card to add 2d8 to any check against a bane that has the Construct, Lock, or Trap trait.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
